beats.event: Visits ancestral graves; identifies with Dam Tien's beautiful tragic fate
Meets scholar Kim Trong and pledges to marry him
Kim Trong departs to mourn his uncle, delaying their union
False charges jail her father and brother; family faces ruin
Sells herself to Scholar Ma, believing she is saving her family
Ma proves a pimp; she is delivered to Madam Tu's brothel
Attempts suicide rather than take clients
Con man So Khanh is hired to seduce and manipulate her
Broken, she submits and works as a prostitute
Student Thuc purchases her from the brothel as concubine
Thuc's wife Hoan Thu kidnaps and enslaves her
Escapes to a temple where nun Giac Duyen shelters her
Sent unknowingly to Madam Bac, who runs another brothel
Marries warlord Tu Hai; they reign together for five years
Ho Ton Hien tricks Tu Hai into surrender; he is killed
She is forced into another marriage to cover the scandal
She throws herself into the Qiantang River
Giac Duyen, forewarned, rescues her from the water
Kim Trong, now an official, finds her and reunites the family
Marries Kim Trong but refuses intimacy, honoring her youthful vow
